mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, real_name, email, phone, status, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT id,username,real_name,email,phone,status,create_time FROM sys_user ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, real_name, email, phone, status, create_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, NOW())
